title: cloud-connection: controlPlaneUrl's docblock says '' declares "this runtime IS the cloud"; the constructor, README and serve.ts say "stay on this origin", and the CLI's cloud-connected arm passes '' while proxying a control plane
body:
Filing gate ①, class (b). One published contract has two meanings in the producer's own docs, and a reader built on the wrong one shipped a false user-facing hint. `reach:` the exported type `RuntimeConfigPluginConfig` of `@objectstack/cloud-connection` (`src/index.ts:57`), whose docblock is what a consumer reads.

Reader: the objectstack-wide triage seat's first touch. It grades the card and routes it.

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` in objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included:
- "RuntimeConfigPluginConfig controlPlaneUrl empty string docblock this runtime IS the cloud versus stay on this origin cloudUrl meaning": 3 hits, all closed and each a different defect on this surface (#14514, #8389, #8355).
- "cloud-url isControlPlaneDeclined empty controlPlaneUrl same origin is the cloud": 1 hit, closed and different (#16450).

## What the producer says, at objectstack `main` `1fb274e6`

| where | what `controlPlaneUrl: ''` means |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts` `RuntimeConfigPluginConfig.controlPlaneUrl` docblock (about `:501`–`:506`, exported) | "Pass an explicit empty string to declare **"this runtime IS the cloud"** (same-origin for marketplace + install)." |
| `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-url.ts` `isControlPlaneDeclined`'s docblock (about `:55`) | "`''` is also how a host says **"this runtime IS the cloud"** (same origin)" |
| the same plugin's constructor comment (about `:707`) | "An explicit empty string means **"stay on this origin"**" |
| `packages/cloud-connection/README.md` (about `:53`) | "**"stay on this origin"** rather than "unset"" |
| `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` `Serve.RUNTIME_CONFIG_OPTIONS` docblock (about `:1706`) | the constructor special-cases `''` as **"stay on this origin"** |

`Serve.RUNTIME_CONFIG_OPTIONS` passes `controlPlaneUrl: ''` on both CLI arms (about `:3845`, `:3901`). The cloud-connected arm also mounts `MarketplaceProxyPlugin`, which forwards to `resolveCloudUrl()`, the default `https://cloud.objectos.ai`. So on that arm the "this runtime IS the cloud" reading is false, and the "stay on this origin" reading is true. `cloud-url.ts`'s own docblock records the both-arms fact one paragraph further on.

## What the wrong reading cost

objectui read `''` the docblock's way: its `runtime-config.ts` said "the runtime we're attached to *is* the cloud". Browse Marketplace then told a proxying runtime "This runtime serves the marketplace catalog itself." That is objectui#11726, fixed on the consumer side by PR objectui#11740, which reads `''` as "requests stay on this origin" and nothing more.

That card's Done-when asks that the key "means one thing on both sides, written in both repos' docs". The objectui half lands with PR objectui#11740. This card carries objectstack's half.

## Done when
- The two docblocks that say "this runtime IS the cloud" say what the constructor does: `''` keeps requests on this origin, and the runtime may serve the catalog itself or proxy a control plane it does not name. No behaviour changes.
- objectui's `AppShellRuntimeConfig.cloudUrl` doc (after PR objectui#11740) and this package's docblock say the same thing.

Not this card: whether the runtime config should name the upstream plane. objectui#11726's triage ruled out adding a key.
